editorial.blurb: A beloved hidden gem tucked inside Joong Boo Market, JB Snack Corner serves authentic, home-style Korean comfort food with genuine warmth and excellent value.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or call ahead—popular items like Korean fried chicken and steam buns sell out on busy days. The outside food stall booth often has items prepped fresh by the same kitchen crew as the inside location.
